name: BBMP/GBA e-Aasthi 2.0 — e-Khata & B-to-A Khata Pre-Audit
governing_act: BBMP Act 2020, Section 109 & GBA Act 2024, Section 44
required_documents: Previous owner's e-Khata extract (not older than 6 months)
BBMP SAS Property Tax paid receipts (last 3 years)
No-dues certificate from BWSSB (for occupied property)

validation_rules.message: Applicant name on application does not match property owner name on e-Khata / Sale Deed. Initial abbreviation (e.g., 'R. Kumar' vs 'Ramesh Kumar S') or transliteration mismatch will cause automatic rejection.
validation_rules.remediation: Submit a Sworn Affidavit (Rs. 100 stamp paper) declaring the name equivalence, attested by a Class-I Gazetted Officer or Notary. Attach Aadhaar and PAN as supporting proof of identity.

validation_rules.message: SAS Property ID (PID) / e-Aasthi Property ID is missing or blank. This is mandatory for all e-Khata applications under GBA Act 2024.
validation_rules.remediation: Obtain the SAS PID from BBMP Citizen Portal (bbmpeaasthi.kar.nic.in). If the property has never been assessed, file a Fresh Assessment Application at the nearest ARO office.

validation_rules.message: Built-up area on the application differs from the assessed area in BBMP records by more than 5%. Applications with area variance > 5% are auto-rejected by the GBA system.
validation_rules.remediation: Commission a licensed BBMP Empanelled Surveyor to re-measure the property. Submit the survey report with a fresh building plan approval if additions were made post-approval.

validation_rules.message: Ward/Zone claimed on the application does not match the pincode-mapped ward in BBMP records. This causes ARO routing failure and automatic return of the application.
validation_rules.remediation: Verify the correct ward by entering your property address on BBMP Citizen Services Portal or by visiting the nearest ARO office.

validation_rules.message: Application submission date + 15 Sakala working days has elapsed without disposal. Citizen is entitled to escalate to First Appellate Authority (ARO to RO).
validation_rules.remediation: File a Sakala SLA Breach Complaint at sakala.kar.nic.in or the nearest Nada Kacheri. Attach the original Sakala GSC acknowledgement number.
validation_rules.reference: Karnataka Sakala Services Act 2011, Section 8 & Oct 2026 Amendment Circular

name_mismatch_affidavit.document_title: Name Equivalence Affidavit for e-Khata Application
name_mismatch_affidavit.english:
AFFIDAVIT

I, [APPLICANT_NAME], son/daughter of [FATHER_NAME], aged [AGE] years, residing at [ADDRESS], PIN [PINCODE], Bengaluru, do hereby solemnly affirm and declare as follows:

1. That I am the applicant for e-Khata transfer/mutation for property bearing SAS PID No. [PID_NUMBER] situated at [PROPERTY_ADDRESS], Ward: [WARD_NAME], BBMP Zone: [ZONE_NAME].

2. That my name as appearing on the Application Form is '[APPLICATION_NAME]' and my name as appearing on the Sale Deed / Previous e-Khata Extract is '[DOCUMENT_NAME]'. Both names refer to the same individual — myself.

3. That the difference in name is due to initial abbreviation / transliteration variation and not due to any fraudulent misrepresentation.

4. I hereby undertake to submit additional identity proof (Aadhaar: XXXX XXXX [AADHAAR_LAST4]) to establish the equivalence of my identity.

Solemnly affirmed at Bengaluru on this [DATE].

Deponent: [APPLICANT_SIGNATURE]

Verified before me:
Notary / Gazetted Officer Seal & Signature
name_mismatch_affidavit.kannada:
ಪ್ರಮಾಣಪತ್ರ

ನಾನು, [ಅರ್ಜಿದಾರರ_ಹೆಸರು], [ತಂದೆಯ_ಹೆಸರು] ಅವರ ಮಗ/ಮಗಳು, ವಯಸ್ಸು [ವಯಸ್ಸು] ವರ್ಷಗಳು, ನಿವಾಸ ವಿಳಾಸ [ವಿಳಾಸ], ಪಿನ್ [ಪಿನ್_ಕೋಡ್], ಬೆಂಗಳೂರು, ಈ ಮೂಲಕ ಸ್ವಯಂಪ್ರೇರಿತವಾಗಿ ಘೋಷಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ:

೧. ನಾನು SAS PID ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ [PID_ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ], ವಾರ್ಡ್: [ವಾರ್ಡ್_ಹೆಸರು], BBMP ಜೋನ್: [ಜೋನ್_ಹೆಸರು] ಆಸ್ತಿಗೆ ಇ-ಖಾತಾ ವರ್ಗಾವಣೆಗೆ ಅರ್ಜಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸಿದ್ದೇನೆ.

೨. ಅರ್ಜಿ ಫಾರ್ಮ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ನನ್ನ ಹೆಸರು '[ಅರ್ಜಿ_ಹೆಸರು]' ಎಂದಿದ್ದು, ಮಾರಾಟ ಪತ್ರ/ಇ-ಖಾತಾ ಎಕ್ಸ್‌ಟ್ರಾಕ್ಟ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ '[ದಾಖಲೆ_ಹೆಸರು]' ಎಂದಿದೆ. ಎರಡೂ ಹೆಸರುಗಳು ನನ್ನನ್ನೇ ಸೂಚಿಸುತ್ತವೆ.

೩. ಹೆಸರಿನ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸವು ಆದ್ಯಕ್ಷರ ಸಂಕ್ಷೇಪ / ಲಿಪ್ಯಂತರ ವ್ಯತ್ಯಾಸ ಕಾರಣದಿಂದ ಆಗಿದ್ದು, ಯಾವುದೇ ವಂಚನೆ ಅಲ್ಲ.

ಬೆಂಗಳೂರಿನಲ್ಲಿ [ದಿನಾಂಕ] ರಂದು ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.

ಅರ್ಜಿದಾರರ ಸಹಿ: [ಸಹಿ]

ನೋಟರಿ / ಗೆಜೆಟೆಡ್ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿ ಮುದ್ರೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಹಿ
